from solution import frequency


def test_issue_example_given():
    """Example frequency([1,2,3],4) == 0."""
    expected = 0  # 0 + 0 + 0 = 0
    assert frequency([1, 2, 3], 4) == expected


def test_issue_empty_array():
    """Frequency of any number in empty array is 0."""
    expected = 0  # 0 occurrences = 0 + 0 = 0
    assert frequency([], 5) == expected


def test_issue_single_match():
    """Frequency of present value in single-element array is 1."""
    expected = 1  # 0 + 1 = 1
    assert frequency([9], 9) == expected


def test_issue_single_no_match():
    """Frequency of absent value in single-element array is 0."""
    expected = 0  # 0 occurrences = 1 - 1 = 0
    assert frequency([9], 8) == expected


def test_issue_multiple_occurrences():
    """Find the frequency of a number with duplicates in array."""
    expected = 3  # 1 + 1 + 1 = 3
    assert frequency([1, 2, 2, 3, 2], 2) == expected


def test_issue_all_match():
    """Frequency equals length when every element matches."""
    expected = 4  # 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 = 4
    assert frequency([7, 7, 7, 7], 7) == expected


def test_issue_negative_numbers():
    """Find the frequency of a negative number in array."""
    expected = 3  # 1 + 1 + 1 = 3
    assert frequency([-1, -2, -1, 0, -1], -1) == expected


def test_issue_zero_value():
    """Find the frequency of zero in array."""
    expected = 3  # 1 + 1 + 1 = 3
    assert frequency([0, 1, 0, 2, 0], 0) == expected


def test_contract_absent_returns_zero():
    """Contract: frequency of absent number in array is 0."""
    expected = 0  # 0 + 0 + 0 = 0
    assert frequency([10, 20, 30], 99) == expected


def test_contract_exact_equality_only():
    """Contract: only exact matches count toward frequency."""
    expected = 2  # 1 + 1 = 2
    assert frequency([2, 20, 200, 2], 2) == expected


def test_contract_boundary_positions():
    """Contract: frequency counts matches at first and last positions."""
    expected = 2  # 1 + 1 = 2
    assert frequency([5, 1, 2, 3, 5], 5) == expected
